name: SPA paired repeated future consequences v1
question: Does averaging paired stochastic continuations improve acquired sentence-action selection with identical source features, model capacity, objective, state order and fit budget?

body.architecture: 128-wide, two-layer, four-head RoPE/RMSNorm/SwiGLU transformer; hidden 384; 94 Unicode characters; context 64
body.numerical_engine: upstream notorch.c linked with the independent C experiment runner

source_exposure.training: The 48 states at seeds42/73 and their original r0 outcomes were inspected in the scenario and future experiments. Repeat1..7 outcomes have not been generated before this protocol.
source_exposure.diagnostic_only: All48 previous evaluation states at seeds101/211 are exposed. Diagnosis and conditioning receipts use them; they are excluded from new training and evaluation.
source_exposure.evaluation: Seeds307/401 have not been generated or inspected before this protocol.
source_exposure.known_geometry: Target3 H4 continuation overwrites the initial intervention before reading it. Report each target separately; do not change the continuation.

training.order: Seed42 snapshot0..23, then seed73 snapshot0..23, repeated in the same order every epoch.
training.other_config: nt_spa_agent_config_default unchanged, including raw reward coefficients and costweight.
training.initialization: Each arm starts from the same canonical newly initialized life. Its online history,counters and RNG remain unchanged during replay; captured source features carry the original sentence/action history.
training.initial_arm: Saved before fitting and never fitted.
training.target: Per-action native mean clipped reward minus native mean clipped KEEP reward. single_h4 uses r0 only; both mean8 arms use r0..7.
training.objective: Mean Huber loss with delta1 across all and only valid action heads. Compute all head/hidden gradients from one pre-update policy; SGD rate0.03, existing parameter bounds[-8,8].

shuffle.group: Identical(sentence_count,target index), preserving typed action coordinates and mask.
shuffle.order: Original global training row order within each group.
shuffle.donor: The next row in the group with cyclic wraparound: donor_index=(receiver_index+1)mod group_size.
shuffle.transform: Keep receiver features and feature-source identity; copy all8 fullH4 comparisons from the donor and bind each training-input source field to the receiver. Retain donor identities and every raw outcome record separately.
shuffle.question: Does correct association of a sentence state with its future outcomes improve selection beyond acquired action preferences?

training.no_adaptation: No changes to target,horizon,rate,epoch count,ordering,capacity or body recipe after experiment fitting/evaluation begins.
training.control_question: Does repeated consequence measurement improve selection at the same feature/model/update budget?

evaluation.seal_before_generation: All8 canonical life files, both complete training fit traces, both training datasets and their source/protocol hashes are sealed before any307/401 body process starts. Verify both seals before and after evaluation.
evaluation.state_source: Unchanged spa_agent_demo learned-arm ordinary trajectory with diagnostics enabled. The policy under evaluation reads captured features; the reference host retains its existing online behavior.

generation.initial_prompt_selection: SplitMix64 samples the sorted corpus sentence-start offsets (first character and the character after .!? followed by whitespace); choose 16 following codepoints.
generation.base_chain: Generate the complete four-sentence chain once per episode and seed; clone it into every arm before intervention. Store every generated token and termination flag.
generation.rng: Independent SplitMix64 generation stream per episode/slot. Reseeds use the same per-seed/episode/decision stream in every arm. Policy RNG is separate.

evaluation.intervention_rng: Exactly the replication section streams for each source and replicate.

continuation.horizon_meaning: Number of additional fixed host reseeds after the initial intervention; horizon 0 is its immediate consequence.
continuation.future_action: RESEED_LEFT if future_target>0; otherwise RESEED_RIGHT. This is a frozen diagnostic host continuation and performs no agent learning.
continuation.future_host_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f66757472, episode_index*4 + decision_index, hop), independently constructed at every hop and identical across initial alternatives.
continuation.generation: The same parent 3-character-neighbor, min 12/max 64, temperature 0.8 recipe at every hop.

evaluation.readout: Actual import SPA calls native pure greedy score_experience on identical29features for all4saved lives; boundary masks and KEEP-first exact ties unchanged. No learning or RNG/history mutation.
evaluation.execution_association: Join each native typed choice to that source state's actually executed alternative branch and complete raw measured trajectory. Retain both source identity and selected outcome-record identity.
evaluation.paired_host_gate: For each new seed run ordinary diagnosticsOFF andON; require complete byte-identical ordinary JSONL and all five saved lives. Complete scenario stream must contain24snapshots60forks180measurements.

replication.source: Restore the exact imported sentence chain, reseed counts, captured29features, source identities, and RNG witnesses for each source and initial action. No reconstruction claim for the unavailable original online agent struct.
replication.paired: Precompute each (source,replicate,hop) start RNG outside the action loop. Every valid initial action shares that start. Each future hop has its own independently constructed start, regardless of earlier consumption.

continuation.horizon_meaning: Number of additional fixed host reseeds after the initial intervention; horizon 0 is its immediate consequence.
continuation.future_action: RESEED_LEFT if future_target>0; otherwise RESEED_RIGHT. This is a frozen diagnostic host continuation and performs no agent learning.
continuation.future_host_rng: stream(seed, 0x7370615f66757472, episode_index*4 + decision_index, hop), independently constructed at every hop and identical across initial alternatives.
continuation.generation: The same parent 3-character-neighbor, min 12/max 64, temperature 0.8 recipe at every hop.

replication.measurements: Retain complete H0,H1,H4 token chains, termination, RNG consumption, seven raw axes and cumulative cost. Fit H4 only.
replication.native_aggregation: Compute each consequence reward using existing native float component arithmetic, double weighted sum, float cast and clipping to[-1,1]. Accumulate those clipped float rewards in double in replicate order and cast the mean to float for each action. Target is float(mean_reward[action]-mean_reward[KEEP]). Never average raw axes before reward clipping.
replication.count1: Native fit_repeated with count1 delegates to fit_comparison exactly, including receipt and state bytes.
replication.one_update: Exactly one simultaneous native mean-Huber SGD update per state per epoch, regardless of replicate count.

measurement.cost: Cumulative generated characters / (64*(horizon+1)), exactly the parent host.
measurement.primary: Across48 new source states, mean paired H4 advantage over KEEP averaged across r0..7. Compare mean8_h4 with single_h4, initial/KEEP and shuffled_mean8.
secondary: Separate r0 and r1..7 mean paired advantage
Measured-best choices and mean regret against per-state mean8 best valid action
Each raw axis and generation cost separately, including chosen-minus-KEEP differences
Action counts, per-seed and per-target tables
Within-state sample variance of paired action-minus-KEEP reward over8replicates; paired standard error sqrt(variance/8)
Between-state variance of each mean paired advantage; sign disagreements across replicates
Selected-action source and raw outcome identity joins for every arm
Training results reported separately from new-state results
measurement.sample_unit: 48 source states, nested in two generation seeds. The384 state/replicate combinations are repeated outcomes, not384 independent states.
measurement.reward_precision: Report native clipped rewards and targets as authoritative; any independent arithmetic check names its tolerance.

execution.schedule: Generate training repeats for both complete executions, fit all4arms in both executions and seal them, then generate any307/401 ordinary source or repeated outcome. Up to4 independent native child processes per stage (two seeds times two executions), each owning its body, RNG, files and counters.
execution.threads: Retain the parent host native thread settings. Parallel child processes change scheduling, not numerical configuration.
execution.sources: Compile and run an immutable snapshot of all measured sources and protocol. Recheck hashes before and after every stage.
execution.barrier: All8 canonical life files, both complete training fit traces, both training datasets and their source/protocol hashes are sealed before any307/401 body process starts. Verify both seals before and after evaluation.
execution.determinism: Compare all retained raw traces, datasets, native fit/readout records, policy lives and summaries byte-for-byte across the two executions. Timing metadata is reported separately.

gates: Existing SPA sensory arithmetic, disabled path and original v1 life continuation remain byte-identical.
Native repeated API count bounds1..64, malformed sources/actions/masks/horizons/common-before, pending state and overlap rejected before mutation.
Count1 repeated fit reproduces the original comparison update, receipt and canonical life exactly.
Synthetic clipped-before-average fixture distinguishes mean reward from reward of mean axes.
Finite differences cover all267 policy parameters; replay changes only policy bytes; save/resume and acquired-weight counterfactual hold.
Deliberate action, credit-sign and aggregation defects are caught.
Strict source import rejects malformed coordinates, lengths, IDs, termination, witnesses and trailing input; output creation preserves all input files.
Exactly48 ordered sources,8 ordered replicates, all valid actions and H0/H1/H4 measurements; missing, duplicate, reordered and misassociated records are caught.
Every source r0 measurement line is byte-identical to the retained parent measurement at the same source/action/horizon.
New single_h4 canonical life SHA256 is3f8fa08f331a1c34d50201e0c5c567ca1b2b1853e6c9b54de265c9886b0d02cb before new-seed generation.
Fresh source diagnosticsOFF/ON reproduce ordinary trace and all5lives exactly; diagnosticsON has24snapshots60forks180measurements perseed.
Every action branch restores body weights, counters, training mode, tape and imported source bytes; paired RNG starts and consumption match the protocol.
Policy readout uses captured source features only and changes no life bytes; outcomes enter only the subsequent measured-choice join.
Source stability, whole-trace completeness, archive readback and two-execution byte identity are mandatory.

scope.frozen: No adaptation of capacity, features, reward coefficients, continuation, rate, epochs, row order, seeds or replicate count after new rollout generation or fitting begins. Negative results retained.
scope.deferred: Feature conditioning, different fit budgets/order, explicit neighbor suffix representation and second model bodies are separate future experiments.
scope.architecture: Native upstream notorch, stdlib Python binding to C arithmetic, independent SPA files. No dependency on unmerged Chuck code; no model/checkpoint vendoring.
